scope: 112 four-second one-factor native recordings on the lower-series legacy-sensor candidate. This is sensitivity evidence, not a joint uncertainty allowance or full-range qualification.
metric: max(abs(normalContact.data(:,1)-reference)) over every native sample including startup; contact/travel/overcurrent/incomplete/impact and configured spring packing also fail.
assumptions: B=0.6 kg; lower spring19746 N/m plus damper60 Ns/m; upper rigid; 64 MN/m massless series cell; physical startup current uses actual masses/Kf; force/acceleration100us EMA plus100us transport; controller PI0.3/20, 1kHz Butterworth feedback, proper identified lower-link inverse1.5kHz; issued robot predictor80/60ms and recenter gain0.735294/s held fixed.
interpretation: Only actual robot transport mismatch produced normal-force failures in this cohort. Large extra IMU noise can pass force tolerance while briefly clipping voltage/current command. Do not infer bias/scale/timing tolerances from output RMS noise.
